# Python dependencies for the thesis experiments.
#
# IMPORTANT — install in this order:
#
# 1. PyTorch with CUDA 12.1:
#    pip install torch==2.5.1 torchvision==0.20.1 torchaudio==2.5.1 \
#        --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu121
#
# 2. PyTorch Geometric (CUDA-specific wheels required):
#    pip install torch-scatter torch-sparse torch-cluster torch-spline-conv \
#        -f https://data.pyg.org/whl/torch-2.5.1+cu121.html
#    pip install torch-geometric==2.7.0
#
# 3. Everything else:
#    pip install -r requirements.txt
#
# If you have a different CUDA version, adjust the --index-url and -f URLs accordingly.
# See https://pytorch.org/get-started and https://pytorch-geometric.readthedocs.io/en/latest/install/installation.html
